meta.title: UniqueGroupsView

fields.name: groupId
fields.mapping: Signal Captured.groupId — empty/absent represents the permanent 'None' row

fields.name: groupName
fields.mapping: GroupsView.name (looked up by groupId), or literally 'None' when groupId is empty

fields.name: assignedProject
fields.mapping: latest:Signal Assigned To Project.projectId for this groupId's most recent signal

meta.description: A signal is hidden once its signalId appears in any SignalsArchived.signalIds, same rule as SignalsListView — a group row's count/preview reflect only its still-unarchived signals; the row itself disappears once all its signals are archived. The 'None' row (signals with no WhatsApp group, i.e. direct messages) is always sorted first regardless of recency; remaining rows sort by latestReceivedAt descending. A row's badge shows a grey '?' instead of a project number/colour when its remaining signals span more than one assigned project.
